SUBJECT'             FACTORY MANUFACTURED HOMES
                     Correction to TPPN No. 6 of 1988




Technical Policy and Procedure No. 6/88 states that manufactured
residential buildings not more than two-stories in height are under
the jurisdiction of the State of New York.

This office has been advised by the New York State Division of Housing
and Community Renewal that a basement as defined by the New York City
Building Code is a cellar by their definition if "the finished floor
immediately above the basement on the average is less than seven (7)
feet above the finished grade."

Therefore, any two-story factory manufactured residential building
that is placed on a basement that has less than seven (7) feet between
legal grade and 1st floor elevation will be under the jurisdiction of
the New York State Division of Housing and Community Renewal.
